Lal report gives two island-city boundary descriptions; neither establishes the current autorickshaw restriction polygon. The taxi/auto committee Part 3 download timed out and remains unobtained. Most ways still lack lane and speed evidence; no class defaults or saturation flows have been adopted. Explicit access-family profiles now retain all 232,856 native road/path records across 12 OSM transport classes, including bus exceptions, motorcycle prohibitions, restricted purposes, malformed values and unresolved qualifiers. Source restriction relation 16357332 has only a via node, with no from/to ways, and remains uninterpretable.
